title: Pendleton Theater & Training Center
intro: Multifunction Movie theater and training facility. Catch the latest box-offices movies at a low price for the entire family. Grab everyone's favorite movie-watching treats at the concession stand. The theater also hosts periodic free early and special viewings of a variety of movies.

sections.markdown: Facility Reservations for Training or private events are also available.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.markdown:
**Movies**

• Adults (12+ years): $8
• Active Duty / Retired: $7
• Kids (6-11 years): $5
• Kids (5 and under): $3

All guests are welcome to movies rated G, PG, and PG-13. For movies rated R, guests under the age of 17 must be accompanied by someone over the age of 18 for the duration of the movie.

Doors open 30 minutes prior to showtime for seating. Arrive early. Times are subject to change based on movie length.

**Concessions**

**Combos**
• VIP Combo (2 regular drinks, large popcorn, and candy): $14
• Matinee Combo (large drink, regular popcorn, and candy): $11.50
• Kids Combo (regular drink and small popcorn): $6
• Kids Large Combo (regular drink, regular popcorn, and candy): $6

**Popcorn**
• Regular: $4
• Large: $5
• Refill: $1

**Drinks**
• Regular: $3
• Large: $4
• Refill: $1

**Candy**
• Gummy Bears, Lifesavers Gummies, M&Ms: regular/peanut, Raisinets, Red Vines, Reese's Pieces, Sour Patch Kids, Starburst Gummies, Twizzlers, Whoppers: $4
